tei:div.tei:p: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku kun tu bzang po de mchod do oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen de mchod do= ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' de= rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje= gu ru shrī sengha= 'chi med padma 'byung gnas= mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal= gter ston karma gling pa= thugs sras nyi zla chos rje= 'gro mgon surya tsand+ra= bka' babs chos kyi rgyal mtshan= sprul sku thugs rje'i 'od zer= 'khrul zhig buddha maṅga= rig 'dzin kun dga' grags pa= gar dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin= rig 'dzin sbas pa'i rnal 'byor= yongs 'dzin rā ga a sye= grub dbang padma kun dga'= mchog sprul phrin las dbang 'byung= kun mkhyen shes rab grags pa= drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma= zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis= 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu= dag pa rig 'dzin lha tshogs= bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho de mchod do oṃ āḥhūm̐/
